The '''42-Y Civilian Speeder Bike''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The 42-Y Civilian Speeder Bike appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vehicle that can be used by players on Nar Shaddaa.
